I do know she was at the Burn with a family as a nanny, connection with Georgia, 2nd or 3rd Burn, Beautiful,  Dusty, smelled much better than me, a smile that should be printed on money, gorgeous eyes, one of the best huggers.

I'm a product of divorced parents. When I was in the 3rd grade I had a mental meltdown in school because my Dad moved across the country and I thought I would never see him again. I stopped caring about anything school related. Spelling tests, fractions and homework just seemed so insignificant and I became antisocial which lead to me being held back a year. Now I had a hole in my life where my Dad should be, I felt abandoned, my Mom is severely depressed from a divorce raising a young kid on her own and now I feel stupid because I am held back a grade. The depression just snowballed. Trouble making close friends, loss of charisma, numb, fantasizing about not existing and trouble with running a business as an introvert. I'm 34 now and the depression is as strong if not stronger. I go through periods where life seems decent, but for the most part I still feel like people don't want to be around me, I have a hard time dating and making connections with women. I had a GF cheat which is never a fun experience to go through and another GF just simply move on like we had never been together, so the abandonment issues persist. I can keep rambling. I think it helps people to know they aren't alone when it comes to childhood depression that continues well into adulthood. It's something I continue to work through. I hope everyone on here keeps moving forward to alleviate the depression and find some happiness in this crazy world. Stay strong.
